info.name: Pipedrive API v1 Activities Channels API

items.docs: Adds a new messaging channel, only admins are able to register new channels. It will use the getConversations endpoint to fetch conversations, participants and messages afterward. To use the endpoint, you need to have **Messengers integration** OAuth scope enabled and the Messaging manifest ready for the [Messaging app extension](https://pipedrive.readme.io/docs/messaging-app-extension).

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the channel provided by the integration

items.docs: Deletes an existing messenger’s channel and all related entities (conversations and messages). To use the endpoint, you need to have **Messengers integration** OAuth scope enabled and the Messaging manifest ready for the [Messaging app extension](https://pipedrive.readme.io/docs/messaging-app-extension).

Adds a message to a conversation. To use the endpoint, you need to have **Messengers integration** OAuth scope enabled and the Messaging manifest ready for the [Messaging app extension](https://pipedrive.readme.io/docs/messaging-app-extension).

params.name: channel-id
params.description: The ID of the channel provided by the integration

params.name: conversation-id
params.description: The ID of the conversation provided by the integration

items.docs: Deletes an existing conversation. To use the endpoint, you need to have **Messengers integration** OAuth scope enabled and the Messaging manifest ready for the [Messaging app extension](https://pipedrive.readme.io/docs/messaging-app-extension).
